complete_pair_palette_control.completeness_argument: A facet of P_t-P_u exposes a sum of two faces with total affine span dimension2. If one exposed face has dimension2, its normal is a face normal of one owner. Otherwise both exposed faces are edges with independent directions, and the facet normal is their cross product. These actual edges, both exact owner frames, all face normals and every edge cross product were enumerated; zero products excluded exactly. The retained normals are precisely candidates exposing a two-dimensional sum face for at least one pair. Hence every pair-difference-body facet direction is retained.
complete_pair_palette_control.scope: Two fixed proper antiprism frames only; no arbitrary-frame recognition or packing optimum claim.

rhombic_contact_control.name: two_flipping_bonds_and_one_preserving_bond
rhombic_contact_control.all_lattice_proof: At a common height, displacement is((m-n)R,(m+n)y)=(uR,vy), with u and v of the same parity and pair parity v mod2. Same-parity nonzero words have even u,v: only(+-2R,0) need the exact diameter contacts; any nonzero v has length>=2y>2R. Opposite-parity words have odd u,v: only(+-R,+-y) need the exact facet contacts; all others have abs(u)>=3 or abs(v)>=3 and length>2R. At different integer heights the complete vertical intervals have disjoint interiors. Each column still alternates and matches the full contact ring.
rhombic_contact_control.scope: Two exact proper frames, this derived rhombic source, all integer words. No angle optimization or arbitrary relative frames.
rhombic_contact_control.negative_bond_rule: Reverse both endpoints and the supporting normal; both ordered opposite-parity types have been checked.

source_control.column_phase_rule: Owner at word(m,n,l) has parity m+n+l mod2. At each common height the two rhombic basis bonds flip parity and their difference preserves parity. Different height levels separate by complete vertical intervals; each column alternates with l. This is a complete physical marked return.
